avis.texte: I have used balm cleansers before, but felt that the jar could get easily contaminated. I decided to try this oil cleanser and i couldnt be happier. It works so well, my skin is extremely soft after use, didnt break me out. I will definitely buy this again!

I live in a dry climate with skin that is both acne-prone and dehydrated. I was battling with oiliness AND flakes, and this product completely fixed that. I cannot recommend this enough. It doesn't irritate my skin at all.

I do like Hanskin products, this not so much. The product is very thin, smells very medicinal. Maybe I got the wrong product, I picked by 3 main ingredients, but the bottle says for dry skin, which I'm a greasy mess. It does seem to break done sunscreen, but the smell makes it not for me.
This is probably the best oil cleanser i have ever used for my large pores, seriously i have never had a cleanser do what this one has to my skin. Will repurchase

avis.titre: I like it but I also don't
avis.texte: I could only use this for 3 days before i had to stop. This one claims to be for dry skin, but it dried my skin out so much and i noticed little red bumps forming. I think from it damaging my skin barrier. Ill go back to using my good molecules cleansing balm daily and just using this maybe once a week to deep clean. If your skin isnt as sensitive this would probably be a great product. It does clean the pores out so good. You can see the dirty and grossness come out on your hands. Just not the best for sensitive skin. But every week or 2 i think ill use it.

I keep coming back to this product as a staple cleanser. I've tried so many oil cleansers and none of them leave my skin as soft and clear as this one. It has a pleasant light scent and easily removes ALL my makeup. I was trying to minimize spending for a while and tried other cleansers… never again. This product is worth the price! A little goes a long way as well.

avis.titre: Was gifted this by a friend and I'm OBSESSED
avis.texte: My friend gave me this cleansing oil a little bit ago and it was so happy because I had JUST run out of cleansing oil and this stuff is AMAZING!!! It really breaks down all the grim, sunscreen, makeup and whatever else is on my skin so seamlessly all while leaving my face very much not dry. I've honestly replaced my regular cleanser with this (for the most part — I still use my regular cleanser but only when my face needs the extra cleaning) and it's been soooo great!! My skin feels way less dry and really clean!

I love this oil cleanser! I was using Tatcha cleansing oil (which I still like, too) but I like this more. One pump removes my makeup and sunscreen. It's a great first step to my double cleanse. I also love how it smells. It leaves a little oily residue. I use foam cleanser afterward to completely freshen up.
Amazing!. Absolutely amazed with this balm.. Gentle, but thorough. And moisturizing. My skin has never felt this clean without feeling stripped.. Highly, HIGHLY recommend.

I alternate this AHA cleansing oil and PHA cleansing oil from this brand. I love how the brand offers a few options of cleansing oils. I use PHA for everyday. However when I would like to get my skin extra smooth and have that extra clean feeling, I reach out for this one. If you can handle AHA, this cleansing oil is simply the best.

avis.titre: My skin has never looked better!
avis.texte: I have only used this a couple weeks. I wear a full face of makeup and this removes everything well with 4 pumps. I double cleanse but don't need to with this. I have always had large pores on my nose. This cleanser has worked miracles! My pores are the cleanest they've been snd have shrunk to remove most of the texture. I would recommend cleanser highly to anyone wanting to clean pores and improve skin texture.

I have been wanting to try a cleansing oil for a while now and decided on this one for my dry combo skin. I am so happy i purchased this, It removes all of my makeup and leaves my skin so soft. I do use another face wash after it but you really don't need to. Has great ingredients, and smells nice too! Definitely give this a try.

Skin feels great after using this. I usually use the balm version of this to take off makeup but I'll use this if I only have a little bit on. I like that it doesn't dry me out and I don't mind the scent. It can get a little gross around the nozzle though since the oil will cling and collect on it; you'll want to wipe the whole bottle down.

When cleansing on a "no makeup" day (only moisturizer and sunscreen applied), it does the job and my skin feels clean but still soft. When cleansing on light makeup days (foundation, concealer, and mascara applied), it works well to remove most of the makeup, but definitely many pumps are needed. There's a lot of product that comes out in each pump, but it seems to absorb(?) quickly when I lather my face. Overall, good as a first step oil cleanse with a convenient pump and pleasant, faint citrus scent!
This is a great oil based cleanser. it gets rid of my makeup easily and it smells nice. It has a citrus scent.

I wanted a cleanser that could remove all my makeup including eye makeup which it does, you do need to use it a couple times to get it all off and I always follow with a tonic my skin feels soft and not dry after using this awesome cleaners. Just ordered my second bottle!

avis.titre: I wish I could love it
avis.texte: It dried out my skin and made my breakouts worse. Wish I was the type of person to return things but unfortunately I still have the full bottle under the sink.

I personally feel like this cleansing oil doesn't remove all my makeup (mascara more so) like the PHA one does. I bought it bc of the AHA, overall it does breakdown most of the makeup and it's easy to remove so my poor do feel clean.

avis.titre: Excellent cleanser with a bit of exfoliation
avis.texte: This worked well for me. I'm 49 with combo/dry skin that gets congested. I use this as the first step to remove makeup (followed with cerave cream to foam cleanser), and for mild exfoliation and like it quite a bit. My skin feels good afterwards and I feel like my toners and serums absorb better. I'm a skincare junkie of 34 years and I highly recommend it ⚡️🙂
I ordered these oil almost 2 weeks back and I regret it، my skin feel like paper sooo drying formula definitely not for dry skin.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin with acne
avis.texte: I waited two months after purchase to review this, and it really has impressed me. I wasn't expecting much but had heard oil cleansing before regular cleanser helped acne, and bought this as my first try with it. I could tell a difference after first use! It made my skin softer and after using regularly, has absolutely helped my skin texture and improved my acne. I have sensitive combo skin so trying new things is kind of a shot in the dark, but this really worked for me. Would definitely recommend!
I love this cleanser. it's soft, lightly smells of lemons, and lathers nicely. my skin feels clean and soft. I use 1 pump for my face.

avis.titre: I'm really enjoying this oil cleanser
avis.texte: I really enjoy this oil cleanser. It easily removes all my makeup and sunscreen, and I usually apply 2-4 layers of sunscreen every day. It rinses clean and doesn't leave any weird residue. I use this as the second step on my cleansing routine, and follow up with a gentle non foaming water based cleanser. For reference, I have dry, sensitive, and acne prone skin. This has not caused any further breakouts and I think this, in combination with the other products in my routine, have helped heal my breakouts and prevent new ones from forming. I think this is a good value for the money because the bottle is huge and I only need one pump per day, so it has lasted me a really long time.

This cleansing oil is perfect for my sensitive/combo skin. It takes all of my makeup off and doesn't sting my eyes. Also doesn't dry out my face. You get a big bottle so in my opinion it's worth the price!

Recently, I've just added oil cleansing to my skincare routine. This does an amazing job of doing the first cleanse. I have slight kp and the moisture left behind helps smooth down those bumps. However, I don't wear a lot of makeup so I'm not aware if it has any trouble getting off makeup. This is a great cleanser and smells amazing. I only wish it had a different dispensing method because you need a lot of product to completely cover your face.

avis.titre: Works good but not for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I was really excited to try this product when I received it and when I opened the package, it was a lot bigger than I thought it would be. I was hoping this product would help my uneven skin texture and blackheads problem. The first day I tried it, I noticed a slight fragrance but it wasn't too bad and it instantly made my skin feel soft and smooth after the first use. I enjoyed using it until I noticed some redness and small bumps forming on my face so I've stopped using it for now to see if it'll go away. It may have to do with the fragrance irritating my sensitive skin. As for blackheads, it seems to not have made much of a difference so I'm not too sure. The product seems to be good other than that :)

I love this product! This works great because of AHA and I have dehydrated skin so it works well in hydrating and cleansing. I like to stay away from oil because it might clog my pores but I don't have to worry about that at all. Such a great gentle cleanser that will do a great job of taking your make up off and won't cause you any irritations. It's also a big bottle that will last me a long time!
I love this cleansing oil. It smells great, it's lightweight, and removes my makeup well. I now use it every night at the beginning of my nighttime routine.

I was so excited when this came in the mail for me. I usually double cleanse and I've been looking for the perfect oil cleanser. However, this one broke me out :( I never broke out this bad, my forehead has texture now with little bumps. Its been 2 weeks, so Im not sure if my skin is just purging and getting used to the product before it does its magic, other factors could've played too (digestion problems, bad sleeping schedule,etc)

I used this nightly for about 3 weeks and followed up with a face cleanser. The oil removes my makeup well, even my waterproof mascara, and washes away easily with water. Note, this oil is fairly strong in fragrance so did irritate my sensitive skin around the cheeks a bit but otherwise, I would recommend. It does the job fairly well.
Great oil cleaner for double cleansing and Its pretty good at taking off my makeup. There isn't really a scent to it, or its just really subtle to me. Ive been really enjoying using it.

I LOVE this product. I usually don't like to use cleansing oil on my face because it smells bad and i don't like the feeling of rubbing oil on my skin. BUT this cleansing oil is perfect for me. It smells good and it gets every make up off after melting them. Thank you Hanskin!! Definitely underrated.

This is an amazing oil cleanser! It seemed to have a lower viscosity than other oil cleansers. Nevertheless, it was highly effective in removing makeup and making my skin feel super clean and refreshed!
Bottled spilled in packaging and pump does not work. The product does not completely remove makeup, but great as a morning cleanser.

I love this cleansing oil. It emulsifies into a nice milky texture so beautifully and rinses off clean. Doesn't leave the usual oily residue that other cleansing oils do. A little goes a long way and I LOVE IT!

avis.titre: Great product but not for sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is a really good oil for double cleansing. I've been double cleansing for a while now to get rid of those little bumps and help keep myself from breaking out as much. This oil also did not make my skin dry out which is a plus. I love this just as much as my cleansing balm from THEN I MET YOU. However this does have AHA so make sure you are using proper sunscreen and moisturizer.

I've used this product for two weeks now and I'm amazing with how well it works with removing my black heads on my nose. I apply some onto a cotton pad and rub it on my nose for about 2 mins. Afterwards, I use the same product to wash my entire face and it makes my face so smooth. I've also used this to remove a full face of make up. It helps break down the make up, although I had to use it about two to three times to complete remove all of it. Overall, I really enjoy this product!
The bottle spilt in the package, and the pump does not work very well. Product does not get rid of all the makeup at night, but is great as a morning cleanser to start!

avis.titre: Finally a cleansing oil that doesn't cloud my vision!!
avis.texte: Im loving this cleansing oil. It removes my makeup well and leaves my skin feeling moisturized yet clean. Love how it emulsifies into a lightweight milky texture that doesn't leave residue on my skin OR in my eyes.

I use this at night as my first step in oil cleansing then I follow up with my regular face cleanser. The oil is a nice texture and washes away nice with water. I massage it into my face and it gets grits/other dead skin off my face, especially around my nose area. It also dissolves waterproof mascara off. One thing to note is that it has a strong fragrance. It smells like a lemongrass/citrus blend. Fragrance doesn't bother me that much but it could irritate sensitive skin.

Ive never enjoyed using oil cleansers because of the way it would make my skin feel after, but this didn't do this to my skin. I can really see how the oil dissolves all my excess oil, dirt, and skin care products off my face. A pump is more than enough to do the job. I've only used it for a week and already I notice that the pores on my nose is less noticeable. I'm very happy with this product.
I have been using this cleansing oil every morning and night. It deeply cleanses my skin leaving it smooth and moisturized. I love how it does not leave any oil residue.

I have been loving this product! It's worked so well for my dry skin. It takes off my makeup and exfoliates, leaving my skin so incredibly soft after. it's so gentle and smooths out my skin texture. It also does a great job of cleaning out my pores. Overall, it's a great product and I would recommend trying it out!

avis.titre: I normally don't use an oil cleanser, but I liked this one
avis.texte: Normally I don't use oil cleansers, but I was surprised at how gentle it was on my skin and didn't leave any oily residue

This was my first time trying out this oil cleanser and I was definitely not disappointed. Because it's the summer my skin has been super dry so I got this AHA one and it worked really well with my skin. I try to avoid any oil based cleansing products since I normally have combination skin and sometimes end up getting clogged pores, but this cleanser was super gentle and did it's job well without causing my skin to break out.
This cleansing oil has been the answer to cleaning out my pores. It is gentle on my skin and easy to use. I saw my pores cleaned out just after the first wash. I use it 2x a day and loving it.

I love double cleansing and this was great for my dry skin. I don't wear make up but like to use it to make sure my sunscreen comes off. I use a very gentle cleanser so I like to double cleanse. I love the packaging as well. I can see how much product I have. And I know I'm going to get every last drop because the plastic tube inside the bottle reaches the bottom. Only con is the smell. It's a light citrus smell which reminds me of cleaning products, but I am slowly getting used to it.
I've never tried a cleansing oil before, but now this product is part of my routine. Gentle, yet effective!

I really like this product a lot. It's easy to use and makes my skin feel good after using it. I tend to have dry skin so this is the perfect product for my dry skin. I don't feel like I need to add moisturizer after cleansing so I feel it saves me a step in my night ritual.

I tend to have dry skin but after using this product for about 2 weeks now, I have nothing bad to say! It For every use, my skin feels more moisturized and hydrated! The product itself leaves my face very smooth and I can see my face to clear up. Would definitely keep using!

This product worked well for removing my makeup. I have combination skin, more towards the oily side and so I don't use this everyday unless it's specifically for removing makeup. But it's nice and easy to work with.

I've used this product as a part of my double cleansing routine for about a week and I think it works pretty well. I prefer this AHA cleanser over the BHA cleanser which left me with a lot of acne (I never break out). It removes make up really well and it is easy to massage into the skin. I think it cleared up some of my acne bumps from before and doesn't leave my skin feeling dry.

avis.titre: Combo skin, but it works well
avis.texte: I have combo skin and have been using this for the past week now. I already saw good results within 2 days. My skin was soft and felt so clean and the next morning I noticed my acne scars already starting to fade. I started to use it with the ordinary niacinamide + zinc and it does wonders for my acne and textured skin.

I use this product as my first step in my night routine. It removes my make up very well without leaving residue. Washes off very well leaving my skin feel refreshed after a long day. Since I haven't been wearing makeup everyday in quarantine, I'll use this around my nose and chin areas for pore care. Since using this product I've noticed the pores around my nose have significantly shrunk! The only issue I've run into while using this product is that it does slightly irritate my cheek area (they are a bit more sensitive). Might be due to the strong scent.

avis.titre: good match for the dry skin
avis.texte: This is the second oil cleanser I'm trying from Hanskin and it's quickly become one of my favorites in my night time rotation. The first oil cleanser I tried from Hanskin was PHA oil cleanser and I really liked it. This AHA oil cleanser works just as good at removing all traces of my make up, however, it does need the foam cleanser to follow as the second step of the cleansing process, where as I feel the PHA oil cleanser doesn't. This AHA cleanser feels a bit heavier as I work the product on my skin but at the same time, very luxurious and cushioning for my dry skin. I found my skin to be bright and fresh after using this oil cleanser and I really liked that my skin didn't feel tight after. I'm definitely going to keep this cleanser in my skin care rotation but I think this AHA oil cleanser might be my "go-to" oil cleanser for the cooler months. I highly recommend this cleanser for anyone with dry skin.

I use this product once daily. A little bit goes a long way. In terms of application- I follow the instructions on the bottle. I have been using this product for a couple weeks now and can notice the improvement in skin texture. I also notice that acne marks seem to fade quicker.

avis.titre: Works great but need more oil to work
avis.texte: Works well for dry and sensitive skin. But as compared to DHC for example, I needed more pumps of this to get the same amount of make up off. So whereas you get more ounces per bottle, you run through the bottle just as quickly as other more expensive brands. So overall a great choice and I would buy again if it was on sale.

avis.titre: SOOO GOOD but there's a catch
avis.texte: I've used an entire bottle of this and it lasted 4 months. I have combination, acne prone, sensitive skin and I wear spf, concealer, powder, bronzer, etc and eyeliner and mascara and it takes it all off. You can definitely feel your skin being exfoliated, my skin was so soft after the first wash. Also, it doesn't leave a film after it emulsifies. However my skin is generally sensitive and it became more sensitive after this. My redness got worse, I started getting dry patches, and my normal cerave hydrating cleanser started to sting. I thought it was because of the change in seasons but after I stopped using this my skin started to get better. I wouldn't recommend if you have sensitive skin.
great for two step cleanse! feels squeaky clean when i do this and my 2nd cleanser! great for winter, when my skin is dry.

I love the light gentle fragrant of the product. I have pretty dry skin and uses this product daily to remove any dirt and make up. I even use it in the showers. I highly recommend cleansing oil as it will help nourish and hydrate the skin. I love how smooth my face feels afterwards. My pores are so thankful!

I have the weirdest skin. I'm dry. I'm oily. I'm sensitive. I have a very hard time finding a face wash that takes off all my makeup, and I've yet to find one that does that doesn't also dry out my skin. I've tried cleansing oils before and a lot of them don't wash off, or they wash off too well and still don't remove everything. This one is PERFECT. It doesn't sting or cloud my eyes, it has a pleasant scent, and it comes off with slightly warm water. It leaves absolutely no residue behind, and not a trace of makeup either. I'm sold. And it's on par with the cost of similar products but you get about 40% more in this bottle at 10oz. Please don't ever stop making/stocking this product. It has become my holy grail skin cleanser.

avis.titre: Love this moisturizing cleanser + make up remover!
avis.texte: I've tried several different cleansing oils and this one is my favorite. I love using this in the evening - it's super moisturizing and easily removes make up (including eye make up). It leaves my skin feeling fresh and smooth. I love the fresh scent and that it uses non-toxic ingredients as well. Definitely recommend!
I love using this product around my eyes knowing it's gentle enough that it won't hurt my eyes and removes my make up! I get dry skin during the winter and this helps hydrate with the mineral oils

I'd never used a cleansing oil before and this is so effective at removing my eye make up—I love it. It completely eliminated a step for me. However, it can be a bit messy. Just by the nature of it being an oil, it's easy for it to drip out of your hands and onto your clothes/sink so be careful!

avis.titre: Nice oil, but prefer the balm
avis.texte: I use this cleanser in the morning around my eyes. (It gently takes off all of the sleep residue) At night I use it all over my face followed by a foaming cleanser.

avis.titre: A LITTLE GOES A LONG WAY
avis.texte: This is one of the many HanSkin products I've incorporated into my night time cleansing routine. I begin by using micellar water to heavily remove the majority of my makeup and then follow up using this pore cleansing oil for a finer, more thorough removal. It works amazing! Not only do you only need to use a small pump of product, but it's also easy to work into your skin, spreadable and leaves you feeling refreshed and cleansed. I have combo skin with certain dry areas and I've found that with this product I no longer feel aware of those dry patches around my brows and nose. I recommend implementing this product into your cleansing routine if you are looking for a lightweight cleanser!

I like this cleanser. It's pretty good and thin for an oil. I thought it would break me out but didn't. I like the pump bottle, so easy to use in the shower. I let my housemates use it too and they enjoy it.

I have been using this product for the past three weeks and am obsessed!!! I love trying new makeup removers and I love how this works great on the face and eyes and IT DOESN'T STING! That is one of my biggest pet peeves because I hate using two different makeup removers. This also doesn't leave a gross film on the skin, so if I was extremely lazy I wouldn't feel like I had to then use another cleanser to fully cleanse my skin. Highly recommend!!!

This oil cleanser is great at getting makeup off. I have used this product for about a month now, and it is hydrating and doesn't leave my skin feeling tight. It goes on super smooth, and when I'm feeling lazy about getting all my makeup off, this cleanser is the only thing I use, and it's incredibly effective and very simple to do.
My skin feels and looks cleaner, better and just less dirty in general. I really like this product.

avis.titre: Great for dry skin to remove excess make up!
avis.texte: I have tried Hanskin's Pore Cleansing Balm AHA, but I definitely like this one more because it moisturizes my skin more.
I've been using this for about a month now and have enjoyed it. It's easy on the skin (doesn't dry my skin out) and does a good job of removing my makeup from the day.

I love this cleansing oil! It really melts away all your makeup when washing your face. It lathers a little so you can see when you've washed it all off and doesn't leave your skin feeling oily. Great for people with dry skin :)

During the fall and winter seasons, my skin gets extremely dry — worse when windy. Every time I use makeup wipes to get rid of my makeup, my face actually starts to sting because it's so dry. I tried this product after sleeping over at a friend's house and immediately bought it the next day. It got rid of all my makeup and it made my skin feel hydrated even after washing it off. HIGHLY recommend for those with dry skin or during cold weather.

avis.titre: I love this cleanser!!! My skin is baby soft after use!
avis.texte: I am in love with this cleanser!! I can't believe I only started using this recently. I've used so many different kinds of cleanser before but this one by far makes my face the softest. After a long day of wearing make up, I look forward to coming home and washing my face. The mineral oil doesn't dry out my skin and my skin feels super soft and smooth after wash.

avis.titre: AHA has been so good to my dry skin!
avis.texte: I've used this product for about a month now and overall it has been super good to my skin! At first, I used it almost every day since it softened my cheeks and forehead well but realized it wasn't great at getting off mascara because it made my eyes cloudy from the oil. I know you're not supposed to use it on the eyes but I get so lazy that I can't help it! This product works well for low makeup days and does a fantastic job of removing any makeup and dead skin from my face. I followed the instructions and applied it dry and then washed with warm water to let it emulsify with the product. AHA has been super great to my skin and although I wouldn't use it on a daily basis, I've been very happy with the results. I definitely recommend this product to others with dry skin!

I use this cleansing oil as the second step in my routine after removing my makeup or sometimes as the makeup remover itself. It melts away the makeup and doesn't leave my skin feeling dry. I've used it for about two weeks, and so far no problems!

avis.titre: feels nice, but not for me
avis.texte: I wanted to like this product but it just didn't work for me. I have oily/acne-prone/sensitive skin. It gave me tiny bumps along my chin after the first night of use. However, It did remove my foundation, but not my mascara. Maybe if you had drier skin, it'll work for you because it felt very moisturizing.
This cleansing oil removes waterproof makeup and sunscreen effectively. It doesn't add any moisture but also doesn't dry out your skin. Great affordable cleansing oil.

I love this cleansing oil, it's very gentle on the face and eye. The cleansing oil didn't irritate my eyes when I was removing my makeup. Also, I love how it doesn't dry up my skin after I have it washed. My skin feels moisturized and supple.

So this product does do what it says, it's non drying and it removes makeup easily. Good for dry skin. When I finally looked at the ingredients, I noticed that mineral oil is the first few ingredients and this worries me. Not a fan of mineral oil when there's so many oils that can do the same but more beneficial in my opinion. If you're not picky like me, then give it a try.

I love the smell of the product. Works well as an oil cleanser, and the pump is easier to dispense than the hanskin balm. I think it does the job especially if you wear makeup everyday. As a normal cleanser, I haven't seen much difference in my skin but it does get the job done.

avis.titre: stayed away from cleansing oil but this product is great
avis.texte: I stayed away from cleansing oils because I don't like the oiliness left behind after rinsing. But as I am getting older, I realize this is not a bad thing. This product left my skin feeling and looking clean and hydrated after use. I liked that it also took my make up off easily. I am very pleased with this product.

avis.titre: Works as a great first cleanse!
avis.texte: I love using this cleanser as the first cleanse in my double cleansing routine. It removes my makeup, doesn't leave an oily residue after being washed off with warm water, and doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped or dry like other cleansing oils I've tried. The scent is also super light and refreshing!!

Lightweight cleansing oil that smells like lemongrass: earthy and citrusy scent. I use it daily to take off makeup, dirt, and dead skin. Really love the AHA for this. It leaves my skin soft and comfortable. Regular soaps usually leave my skin feeling stripped and tight, but not this. Definitely worth a try if you have never used cleansing oil.

This was my first time ever using an oil cleanser and I was really surprised with the results. I tend to have dry skin during the winter time, and this product kept my face feeling fresh and clean without drying it out like some other facial cleansers do. The product has a citrus/gingery scent that I wasn't used to, but it's not a bad scent. Overall, I was really happy with this product!

avis.titre: Great product if you're into waste-free makeup removal!
avis.texte: I am not a huge fan of oil, so I was a bit apprehensive to try this product. When I first applied it on my face, I was surprised at how fast my makeup was rubbing off. And then when it was time to wash my face, the oil emulsified into my skin and I was like "whoa, 2-in-1!" I can tell when a cleansing product is good after I use toner to wipe away left over dirt/makeup. My cotton pad still had some grime, but it wasn't that bad. After several uses, I use face wash to really clean my makeup off. This is overall a good product and I would recommend this to those who are waste-free!

Love love this cleansing oil. I've used a couple other brands before but this one doesn't leave any greasiness or oily film behind. It's great at getting all my makeup off, especially long-lasting lipsticks. Depending on the amount of makeup I've worn that day sometimes I'll double cleanse. The scent is so good, and makes me feel like I'm at a spa. Would highly recommend.
I love how this oil cleansing removes my makeup and leaves my skin feeling hydrated! Didn't know that you wet your hands to emulsify and since doing so have eliminated my second cleanser!

This cleansing oil is pretty good. I've been using it for a week and a half and so far it's what I use first in my routine. It melts away dirt and is pretty gentle. The only thing I'm not a fan of is the mineral oil in the ingredients. I don't know if mineral oil is bad for you but I hear mixed things... but luckily enough I haven't had any bad reactions. What I love is that there are AHA's in the cleansing oil! When you rinse off, your skin feels clean but not tight and dry. Skin is soft and supple!

avis.titre: Works fine but scent is a little strong for me
avis.texte: This is my first time using a cleansing oil and I'd say it worked better than I expected. It melted my makeup off pretty easily and it made my skin immediately soft. The only thing I couldn't get passed was the scent, not because it smells bad but it was just a stronger scent than I'm used to for skincare products. Overall, I would definitely recommend this to a friend that is interested in cleansing oils.
love this oil cleanser. feels so silky and smooth on skin and gets the job done really nicely. also smells amazing.

This is the best cleansing oil I've used yet. I've used a number of these from mid-priced drugstore brands to high end, and none of them come close to this one. It feels light on the skin, melts the most long-lasting and waterproof makeup, doesn't burn my eyes at all, and rinses off easily, clean, and with no residue. An extra added bonus: I think the gentle AHA has been helping to clear up my skin. Plus, this is also the best value I've seen for a cleansing oil. Most cleansing oils are $20-$25 for 5oz, but this is a little more than 10oz for a similar price.
I love to use this as the first step of my double-cleanse routine. It quickly melts away my makeup and leaves my skin feeling super hydrated!
